# qdrant-cloud_serverless_space (Resource)

Serverless Space Resource

## Example Usage

```terraform
// Setup Terraform, including the qdrant-cloud providers
terraform {
  required_version = ">= 1.7.0"
  required_providers {
    qdrant-cloud = {
      source  = "qdrant/qdrant-cloud"
      version = ">=1.30.0"
    }
  }
}

// Add the provider to specify some provider wide settings
provider "qdrant-cloud" {
  api_key    = "" // API Key generated in Qdrant Cloud (required)
  account_id = "" // The default account ID you want to use in Qdrant Cloud (can be overriden on resource level)
}

// Pick the first available serverless cloud region
data "qdrant-cloud_serverless_cloud_regions" "all" {}
locals {
  cloud_region_id = [for r in data.qdrant-cloud_serverless_cloud_regions.all.regions : r.id if r.available][0]
}

// Create a serverless space
resource "qdrant-cloud_serverless_space" "example" {
  name            = "example-space"
  cloud_region_id = local.cloud_region_id

  labels {
    key   = "team"
    value = "search"
  }

  configuration {
    allowed_ip_source_ranges = ["10.0.0.0/8"]
    collection_settings {
      max_size                       = 4294967296 // 4 GiB per collection
      max_indexed_size               = 2147483648 // 2 GiB indexed per collection
      size_warning_threshold_percent = 90         // Warn at 90% of the maximum size
    }
    searcher_settings {
      max_workers = 2
    }
    // Cap the total storage of the space (leave out for unlimited)
    storage_limit {
      max_size                = 10737418240       // 10 GiB
      type                    = "LIMIT_TYPE_HARD" // Reject upserts at the limit (default)
      alert_threshold_percent = 80                // Alert at 80% of the limit (default)
    }
    // Cap the monthly spend on searches and writes (leave out for unlimited)
    monthly_spend_limit {
      max_amount_millicents   = 5000000           // 50 USD (1 USD = 100000 millicents)
      type                    = "LIMIT_TYPE_SOFT" // Only alert at the limit
      alert_threshold_percent = 90
    }
  }

  delete_backups = true // Delete the backups of the space when it is destroyed
}

// Output the endpoint of the space
output "space_url" {
  value = qdrant-cloud_serverless_space.example.url
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Serverless Space Schema Name of the space (4-64 characters: letters, numbers, `-` and `_`). Unique within the account field

### Optional

- `account_id` (String) Serverless Space Schema Account ID (defaults to the provider account ID) field
- `cloud_region_id` (String) Serverless Space Schema Cloud region where the space is hosted (see the `qdrant-cloud_serverless_cloud_regions` data source). Required unless `from_backup_id` is set, in which case the region of the backup is used field
- `configuration` (Block List, Max: 1) Serverless Space Schema Configuration of the space field (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--configuration))
- `cost_allocation_label` (String) Serverless Space Schema Key of the label sent as metadata when metering usage through cloud marketplaces, for cost allocation field
- `delete_backups` (Boolean) Whether the backups of the space should be deleted when the space is destroyed. Defaults to false.
- `from_backup_id` (String) ID of a serverless backup to create the space from. Changing this forces a new space to be created.
- `labels` (Block Set, Max: 10) Serverless Space Schema Labels of the space, used in the cloud UI and billing reports (max 10) field (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--labels))
- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Serverless Space Schema Creation time field
- `id` (String) Serverless Space Schema Space ID field
- `state` (List of Object) Serverless Space Schema Current state of the space field (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--state))
- `url` (String) Serverless Space Schema URL (without port) to access the space field

<a id="nestedblock--configuration"></a>
### Nested Schema for `configuration`

Optional:

- `allowed_ip_source_ranges` (List of String) List of allowed IPv4 source ranges (CIDR) for this space (max 40).
- `allowed_origins` (List of String) List of origins (scheme + host + optional port, e.g. `https://app.example.com`) from which browser-based clients are allowed to call the space via CORS (max 10).
- `collection_settings` (Block List, Max: 1) Per-collection size limits for this space. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--configuration--collection_settings))
- `monthly_spend_limit` (Block List, Max: 1) Limit on the monthly spend of the space for searches and writes combined (storage cost is not included). The spend period is the calendar month in UTC. When not set, spend is unlimited (the default). Removing the block removes the limit. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--configuration--monthly_spend_limit))
- `searcher_settings` (Block List, Max: 1) Search-worker settings for this space. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--configuration--searcher_settings))
- `storage_limit` (Block List, Max: 1) Limit on the total storage of the space. When not set, storage is unlimited (the default). Removing the block removes the limit. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--configuration--storage_limit))

Read-Only:

- `last_modified_at` (String) Time when the configuration was last updated.
- `max_collections_per_space` (Number) Platform-enforced limit on the number of collections for this space (0 means unlimited).

<a id="nestedblock--configuration--collection_settings"></a>
### Nested Schema for `configuration.collection_settings`

Optional:

- `max_indexed_size` (Number) Customer-defined maximum indexed size in bytes per collection. Must not exceed `platform_max_indexed_size` or the effective maximum size (`max_size`, or `platform_max_size` when `max_size` is unset). Defaults to 1 GiB, capped by `platform_max_indexed_size`.
- `max_size` (Number) Customer-defined maximum size in bytes per collection, used for cost control. Must not exceed `platform_max_size` (defaults to 2 GiB, capped by `platform_max_size`).
- `size_warning_threshold_percent` (Number) Percentage of the effective maximum size at which a size warning is sent for a collection (between 40 and 100, defaults to 80).

Read-Only:

- `platform_max_indexed_size` (Number) Platform-enforced maximum indexed size in bytes per collection (0 means unlimited).
- `platform_max_size` (Number) Platform-enforced maximum size in bytes per collection (0 means unlimited).


<a id="nestedblock--configuration--monthly_spend_limit"></a>
### Nested Schema for `configuration.monthly_spend_limit`

Required:

- `max_amount_millicents` (Number) Maximum spend per calendar month, in millicents of `currency`. A millicent is 1/1000 of a cent (0.00001 USD), so 1 USD is 100000 millicents and 50 USD is 5000000. It may be set below the current spend, in which case it takes effect immediately.

Optional:

- `alert_threshold_percent` (Number) Percentage of the limit at which an alert is sent to the account owner (between 1 and 99, defaults to 80).
- `type` (String) What happens when usage reaches the limit. Must be one of: LIMIT_TYPE_HARD, LIMIT_TYPE_SOFT (defaults to `LIMIT_TYPE_HARD`). With a hard limit, all read and write operations (including deletes) are rejected once spend reaches the limit, until the next month starts, or until the limit is raised, switched to a soft limit, or removed. With a soft limit, an alert is sent and all operations keep working.

Read-Only:

- `currency` (String) Currency of `max_amount_millicents`, as a 3-letter ISO 4217 code (currently always `USD`).


<a id="nestedblock--configuration--searcher_settings"></a>
### Nested Schema for `configuration.searcher_settings`

Optional:

- `max_workers` (Number) Maximum number of search workers per collection in this space (defaults to 2).

Read-Only:

- `min_idle_timeout` (String) Platform-defined minimum time a search worker stays idle before it may be scaled down, as a Go duration string (defaults to "5m").
- `platform_max_workers` (Number) Platform-enforced maximum number of search workers per collection (0 means unlimited).


<a id="nestedblock--configuration--storage_limit"></a>
### Nested Schema for `configuration.storage_limit`

Required:

- `max_size` (Number) Maximum total storage of the space, in bytes. It may be set below the current usage, in which case it takes effect immediately.

Optional:

- `alert_threshold_percent` (Number) Percentage of the limit at which an alert is sent to the account owner (between 1 and 99, defaults to 80).
- `type` (String) What happens when usage reaches the limit. Must be one of: LIMIT_TYPE_HARD, LIMIT_TYPE_SOFT (defaults to `LIMIT_TYPE_HARD`). With a hard limit, upserts are rejected once storage reaches the limit, while searches and deletes keep working. Writes resume once storage drops below the limit, or when the limit is raised, switched to a soft limit, or removed. With a soft limit, an alert is sent and all operations keep working.

## Import

`qdrant-cloud_serverless_space` can be imported using the space ID, e.g.

```
$ terraform import qdrant-cloud_serverless_space.example 12345678-0000-0000-0000-1234567890ab
```

Note that `from_backup_id` and `delete_backups` are not returned by the API, so they are not set after import.
